name: business.act60/mcp
title: Act 60 Business
description: Puerto Rico Act 60 and Act 22 decree rules with citations, deadlines and CECFL nonprofits, en/es

tools.name: hello
tools.description: Returns a greeting with the signature and trace lines. Used to check that the server answers.

tools.name: pick_tool
tools.description: Lists the Act 60 tools as cards grouped by lifecycle stage, best matches for the request first. Call it when a request matches several tools or none.

request.description: The user's request, in their words

locale.description: Card language; default: the language of the request

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Reports the state of a multi-day job (for example a donation campaign) by the job id its tool returned.

job_id.description: The job id from the result that started the job

tools.name: next_deadlines
tools.description: Lists the next Act 60 compliance dates for a segment and regime (annual report, CPA report, CECFL list year, federal return, Form 8898, Chapter 3 filings), each with the canon passage that sets it, its verified-on date and regime tag. Dates no verified source states are left out.

segment.description: individual: a decree holder; chapter3: an export services business; all: both lists.

regime.description: pre2027: decree applied for by December 31, 2026; post2027: applied for from January 1, 2027; both: rows of either regime.

decree_year.description: Year the decree was obtained, if known. Starts the donation from the second tax year and dates rules that count from the decree.

locale.description: Response language; default the language of the conversation.

tools.name: calendar_feed
tools.description: Returns an ICS calendar feed URL with the Act 60 compliance dates for a segment and regime, each event citing its rule. No login and no contact; the URL holds only the segment, regime, decree year and language.

segment.description: individual: a decree holder; chapter3: an export services business; all: both lists.

regime.description: pre2027: decree applied for by December 31, 2026; post2027: applied for from January 1, 2027; both: rows of either regime.

decree_year.description: Year the decree was obtained, if known. Starts the donation from the second tax year and dates rules that count from the decree.

locale.description: Language of the calendar text; default the language of the conversation.

tools.name: remind_me
tools.description: Schedules reminders 30, 7 and 1 days before chosen Act 60 deadlines, each citing its rule, on the verified contact of this session only: it never subscribes another address. A guest is asked for a verified contact first. It stores the reminders, the channel and language preference and a subscription id, nothing else.

deadline_ids.description: Deadline ids from next_deadlines (dated deadlines only).

channel.description: Where reminders go: email, sms, telegram or whatsapp.

contact.description: The verified contact of this session on that channel (email address, phone number, Telegram id or WhatsApp number); it must match.

locale.description: Language of the reminders; default the language of the conversation.

tools.name: delete_my_data
tools.description: Deletes the data of the person behind this session and never anyone else’s: with account true, the account this conversation is linked to (every contact and job merged into it); with contact, the verified contact of this session, which must match. Reminders, messages, the forward-to address and the calendar connection stop at once, every record is deleted by the date returned (within 30 days), and a confirmation goes to the same channel.

contact.description: The verified contact of this session (email address, phone number, Telegram id or WhatsApp number); it must match. Give this or account, not both.

account.description: true: delete the account this conversation is linked to, with every contact and job merged into it.

tools.name: ask_canon
tools.description: Answers an Act 60 (Puerto Rico) rule question from a page a person verified against the official texts: a two-sentence answer, the full answer in details (markdown, [n] = citations[n-1]), primary-source citations with quotes, a regime tag (pre2027, post2027, both) and the verified-on date. Answer from details and cite the sources; do not add facts the page does not state. Answers no_citation when no verified page covers the question. Information, not advice.

tools.name: whats_changed
tools.description: Lists the approved change notes on the Act 60 primary sources (Act 60-2019 as amended, Act 38-2026, DDEC, Hacienda, CECFL, IRS) dated on or after `since`, newest first, each with English and Spanish summaries and the source URL. Only notes a person approved are listed; an empty list means no approved change in that period.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); notes dated on or after it
